result.summary: Found 3 visible issues: one major invalid delivery-price value and two minor horizontal clipping/layout problems.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays the invalid price text "€NaN delivery", indicating a failed or unformatted delivery-fee value.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format the delivery-fee data before rendering. Show a valid monetary amount, "Free delivery", or a clear fallback such as "Delivery fee unavailable" when no value is supplied.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel is cut off on the right: the Trattoria Piccolo card, including its name and delivery text, is visibly clipped by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have appropriate trailing padding and use intentional partial-card peeking only if labels remain readable; otherwise size cards so the visible content is not truncated.

issues.description: The category-chip row is also clipped at the right edge, showing part of an additional chip without enough spacing or a visible affordance that the row scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding and an intentional scroll cue, or adjust chip sizing/spacing so the row does not appear accidentally cut off.
